goal:
Setting up a staging deployment of the mailer with just the host in the settings file,
and sending the test email crashes with "KeyError: 'retries'". The docs say every option
except the host is optional and falls back to a sane default — we shouldn't have to spell
out every key just to send one email. Please make optional settings actually optional.
acs: Setting up a staging deployment of the mailer with just the host in the settings file, and sending the test email crashes with "KeyError: 'retries'".
The docs say every option except the host is optional and falls back to a sane default — we shouldn't have to spell out every key just to send one email.
Please make optional settings actually optional.

coverage.statement: Optional settings in mailer config must automatically resolve to sane defaults without requiring explicit user input, preventing KeyError crashes.

hows.text: Approach 1: Implement a robust default fallback mechanism in mailer/config.py. Define a centralized dictionary of default values for all optional settings (like 'retries') and use .get() to safely retrieve them, ensuring missing keys automatically resolve to sane defaults without requiring explicit user input.
hows.reason: This directly addresses the crash by making optional settings truly optional, aligning perfectly with the node goal of avoiding the KeyError and reducing required configuration.

hows.text: Approach 2: Refactor the configuration loading logic to use a flexible, dynamic settings parser. Instead of hardcoding required keys, parse the settings file to dynamically merge user-provided values with a predefined, comprehensive set of default values for all mailer options.
hows.reason: This approach provides a highly flexible and resilient configuration system that guarantees all necessary keys are present with sane defaults, preventing crashes and simplifying the staging deployment.
